_comment: The voice and its locked-in settings. Same shape as voiceover_profile.json,
the file Voiceover Studio writes next to voiceover_studio.py when you tick
'remember' — so you can copy that file here unchanged.
LEAVE api_key OUT. Put the key in the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable
instead, so the secret never sits in a file that gets committed.
calibration.voice is the ElevenLabs voice id, the value the studio's voice
dropdown holds. The four numbers are whatever the Training Studio locked in
for you — the values printed in the '🔒 Locked in:' chat message.
